enemies.name: Atman
enemies.notes: Uses SP Lowering, and inflicts Paralysis, Confusion, Silence, Poison, Petrify, and Ring anomalies

bosses.name: Atman
bosses.strategy:
Atman can still kill Alice in two rounds, so make sure that she stays
healed. As for attacks, this time around, Atman will still use
Eradication, but it won't kill; instead, it'll just do a pretty good
amount of damage, as well as reduce SP. He can also attack normally, as
well as use Dragon Cry and other strong class spells for decent damage.

Have Yuri fuse into Amon and rip into Atman with physical attacks, while
Alice should be using Arc every round to keep their HP maxed. If for some
reason she gets a free turn, have her cast Advent to help Yuri deal some
damage.

Head into Roger's house and talk to him, and he'll have you rest up while he
works on the teleporter. In the meantime, you'll regain control of Alice in
Yuri's Graveyard. Read the tombstones if you like, then go talk to the Masks.
They'll make you go through the doors to the evil dimension to meet Atman, the
god of death. One of two things here will now happen:

1) Alice will enter a battle with Atman, alone. This is what will happen if you
   chose the follow the path to the bad ending. You cannot defeat Atman, and
   after a few turns, he'll cast Eradication and defeat Alice in battle, at
   which point you'll wake back up and regain control in Roger's house.

2) Yuri will come in, and he and Alice both will battle Atman. Here we go...

After the battle, watch the quick scene (and cut-scene, if you defeated Atman),
then you'll regain control.

If you defeated Atman with both Yuri and Alice, there's one more item we can
grab. Before talking to Roger, head back out onto the World Map and choose to
go into the Graveyard. Talk to the Masks here for an event, where you'll
receive the [_SEVEN-EYED MASK_]. Also, to confirm that you are getting the good
ending, read the small tombstone beside the Dark Gravestone; it should now say
"Atman, rest in peace..."

Back in the Nemeton Monastery, talk to Roger. (You may have a sequence
involving the Erotic Book and Pulse Tract first before the story moves on; see
W-S-16 below for the full details.) He'll be finished, and asks you if you wish
to go to Neameeto.

———————————————————————————————————————————
   [1] Wait, I need to use the bathroom!
   [2] Let's go!
———————————————————————————————————————————

(If you choose 1, you may see that Roger is Lottery Member No. 00; see W-S-16
below for the full details.) When you're ready, choose 2 and you'll have to
complete a Spin Ring _5_ (that's right, 15 targets) to have Roger successfully
send you off!


   Neameeto
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯
You've made it! However, now that we've completed the Atman sequence and
stepped foot on Neameeto, we can take on the very last bit of side quests. If
you don't want to do it, skip down to W-2-16 - Final Preparations. Otherwise,
step on the yellow circle in this room to be sent back down to the Nemeton
Monastery!
